integrity: The stated result follows from an analytic finite-sample ratio calculation, beta-mixture CLTs, and a uniform L1 Taylor expansion; included finite checker is corroboration, not an infinite proof. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixes p in (0,1), requires n and initial concentration \(A_n\) both divergent, gives no uniform critical-regime rate and no p-to-boundary statement. Full historical novelty cannot be guaranteed.
title: A sharp total-variation phase diagram for reinforced binary sampling
